influence: A long Retry-After must not become a hidden SDK sleep that exceeds the tool-call budget.
An upstream rate limit or overload must surface after the expected provider call count; one explicit caller owns retries.
Record actual elapsed time and retry counts, and test account boundaries during recovery.
implementation: Original CosmaBot synthetic fixtures and assertions; no third-party source copied, no dependency, no vendor client or runtime changes.
scope: Real Google and Microsoft adapters backed by owned local PostgreSQL and httpx.MockTransport.
Persistent JSON 429, non-JSON 429, and JSON 503 with Retry-After 3600 until explicit synthetic read retry.
One-second local failure-return assertion plus exact provider counts and account-revocation fences.
Existing uncertain fax write and no-resend qualification retained.
limits: The timing assertion measures an immediate synthetic error response, not live-provider latency or a production SLA.
Inspected upstream tests informed scenarios; this file does not claim those upstream tests were executed.
